gaps.sentence: The plane made a hard but ___ (SUCCESS) landing.
His ___ (REFUSE) to cooperate stalled the negotiations.
He was ___ (SUSPECT) of fraud last year.
gaps.explanation: 'Was suspected of' — passive; 'suspicious' describes a person who suspects.

gaps.sentence: He is one of the most ___ (SUCCESS) businessmen in the region.

gaps.explanation: 'Her persistence' — the quality noun from persistent.

gaps.sentence: The medicine may cause ___ (SLEEP), so avoid driving.
gaps.hint: noun: the state of wanting to sleep
gaps.explanation: 'Cause sleepiness' — the noun for the drowsy state.

gaps.sentence: The bacteria are ___ (SEE) to the naked eye.
gaps.explanation: 'Invisible' = impossible to see — the negative adjective from VISIBLE/SEE.
